custom.label: Custom
custom.desc: Custom palettes on a case-by-case basis.

lpcr.label: LPC Revised
lpcr.desc: A palette scheme developed by ElizaWy for her LPC Revised project.

ulpc.label: Universal LPC
ulpc.desc: A palette scheme standard developed by the LPC artists over time and refined.

all.label: Any
all.description: Choose from any palette from any material type (except eyes).

body.label: Skintone
body.description: Palettes designed for skin tones and flesh colors, but may include fantasy colors.

cloth.label: General
cloth.description: Palettes designed for general colors, but especially cloth or fabric.

eye.label: Eyes
eye.description: Palettes designed for eye colors. These only use 3 palettes and are not interchangeable with other types.

hair.label: Hair
hair.description: Palettes designed to look good for hair colors, but also may include fantasy colors.

metal.label: Metal
metal.description: Palettes designed for metallic surfaces such as weapons and armor.

wood.label: Wood
wood.description: Palettes designed for wooden surfaces such as bows and staves.
